posting_text:
Senior Manufacturing Engineer, Battery Module Assembly
Job ID: R-204417 | Location: Fremont, CA | Full time

Voltaris Mobility is building the next generation of electric trucks. Our plants run on SAP, and our line dashboards are written in Python.

Key Responsibilities
- Own the module assembly line from pilot build through high-volume launch
- Lead DFMEA reviews with design and quality partners
- Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for line escapes
- Release work instructions and train operators on new stations

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering
- 5+ years of manufacturing engineering experience in automotive or battery production
- Hands-on experience with GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis
- Working knowledge of statistical process control

Desired Qualifications
- Experience with IATF 16949 and APQP deliverables
- Exposure to battery management systems at the module level
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt
- Proficiency in Python for data analysis

Benefits and Perks
- Medical, dental and vision coverage from day one
- Annual learning stipend that covers MATLAB and SolidWorks certification courses
- On-site gym and free EV charging

Pay Transparency
The base salary range for this role is $128,000 to $165,000 plus equity.

Voltaris is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or veteran status.
